evidence_scope: Read-only arithmetic on previously saved frozen-source first-lap trajectories, starts, and six-carry qualifications; no new execution, training, solver call, FP2 access, or budget expenditure.

source_formulas.c_i: reference DC deployment energy in block i (MJ) / f_ref_i
source_formulas.pinned: u_i = u_ref_i if any saved decision state_after_decide phase in block i is not NORMAL
source_formulas.terminal_energy_constraint: e[-1] >= initial_energy; all e in [2,4] MJ

interpretation.conclusion: All three cold reference surrogates have zero useful feasible action sensitivity. Two have no free positive-deployment coefficient; the third has one coefficient but the terminal-speed equality uniquely fixes it back to the reference up to endpoint roundoff.
interpretation.solver_evidence: Saved CasADi proposal actions are not evidence of a sensitive energy/time optimum. Arbitrary movement of zero-coefficient columns cannot change this surrogate objective.
interpretation.cold_vs_carried: Cold E=2 MJ is the floor, making the first free block inactive. Six-carry qualification begins later laps with accumulated energy, so that same action column may become active. Exact carried results remain meaningful but do not demonstrate optimization of a sensitive six-carry surrogate.
interpretation.tail: The final 1000 m experimental no-new-deployment guard is distinct from a FIA rule; the late free columns have zero deployment here.
interpretation.baseline_raw_saturation: Baseline raw action is exactly 0, mapping to half of the then-available request cap on nonnegative wheel demand; it never hits the raw [-1,1] bound. Strong geometry, energy, tail, and FSM restrictions dominate available timing authority.
interpretation.available_wheel_and_state_caps_limit: Saved decision averages, predecision public caps, and guard requests are different stages. Actual kernel jointly limits force at beginning/mid/end, energy reserve, wheel demand, speed cap and slew. No exact single-cause attribution or unmeasured pointwise ICE headroom subtraction is inferred from these averages.
interpretation.request_vs_execution: Positive executed DC with zero outgoing request can be committed HOLD/ramp/slew, and positive request with zero average execution can be clipping/phase/force effects; neither by itself proves illegality.
interpretation.phase_allocation_limit: Phase-weighted deployed energy uses phase after decide and whole decision averages; within-decision transitions are not resolved by these totals. Filter categories overlap.
interpretation.exact_pattern_search: Registered exact pattern search can modify columns pinned by this surrogate and change actual FSM timing. It remains a finite comparison within the frozen budget.
interpretation.future_method_hypothesis: A future separately preregistered surrogate could retain deployment authority across carried energy/state boundaries and use action bases that do not pin every sensitive column; do not alter this frozen run.

source_unit_audit.reference_deploy_units: Internal DC power is kW; deploy=cumsum(positive_dc_kw*dt_s/1000), so deploy and c_i have units MJ.
source_unit_audit.source_power_delta_units: c_i/dt_i*1000 has units kW. The source inserts this number directly into 2*power_delta*ds/(mass*speed), which requires watts for a squared-speed increment in SI.
source_unit_audit.implication: Where coefficients are nonzero, the written surrogate velocity response is 1000 times smaller than an SI mechanical-power perturbation. This is a source arithmetic/model-surrogate limitation, not a correction applied to any frozen result.
source_unit_audit.authority_conclusion_unchanged: Multiplying a zero free coefficient by 1000 remains zero. One free nonzero column is still uniquely fixed by the terminal-speed equality, though the small roundoff-closing numerical change would differ.
